name: Demos
description: Lists and downloads the server-side demo files an instance recorded, newest first, with every file of one match collapsed into a single row labelled with its map, mode, players and length (from the match's {match_id}.meta.json, else the engine's filenames), and filters by date preset, map, mode and pack state. Recognises raw .dm_91 by default; other addons (e.g. qlmatch-packer) extend the recognised formats via the demo_management.file_kinds hook and add per-match actions via demo_management.match_groups. Needs QLSM with ui_api 3 or newer - the screen is the addon's own component and renders its whole dialog.
